notes: The 'Starting . . .' block (BHBM Objective, Death Star II Throne Room, Insignificant Rebellion, Your Destiny, Prepared Defenses, Mobilization Points, Imperial Arrest Order, Battle Order) repeats cards that are also listed in their sections, so it is not counted twice; the sections total 60 as published. 'Cards that Alter or Stop my "reacts"' and 'Cards I Wish I Had Room For' (Come Here You Big Coward, Mara Jade's Lightsaber, Vader's Lightsaber, Empire's New Order, General Veers, Myn Kyneugh, Force Pike, etc.) after the list are not part of the deck.
